description: Resonant band-pass filter with a choice of two circuits

params.text: Sets the centre frequency, five octaves either side of 523.25Hz, so from 16.35Hz at the bottom to 16744Hz at the top
Sets the resonance, 1 to 20 in both modes
Chooses the filter: STANDARD is a Korg-style Sallen-Key band pass, OBERHEIM models the filter in the SEM

inputs.text: Shifts the centre frequency one octave per volt, added to the CUTOFF knob, and the total is held to five octaves either side of 523.25Hz

notes: The CUTOFF knob's tooltip reads 261hz to 1046hz, but the knob actually sweeps 16.35Hz to 16744Hz.
